blocks.name: review_demand
blocks.sql: SELECT e.product_id, e.timestamp, COUNT(r.review_time) AS reviews_all, COUNT(r.review_time) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS reviews_7d, COUNT(r.review_time) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS reviews_30d, COUNT(r.review_time) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '91 days') AS reviews_91d, COUNT(r.review_time) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '182 days' AND r.review_time < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '91 days') AS reviews_previous_91d, COUNT(r.review_time) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days') AS reviews_365d, DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(r.review_time), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_review, DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(r.review_time), e.timestamp) AS days_since_first_review, AVG(r.rating) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '91 days') AS rating_91d, AVG(CAST(r.verified AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '91 days') AS verified_share_91d, p.price AS product_price, COUNT(r.review_time) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS recent_review_count_30d, COUNT(r.review_time) FILTER (WHERE r.review_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '91 days' AND r.review_time < e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS previous_review_count_61d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.product_id LEFT JOIN review r ON r.product_id = e.product_id AND r.review_time < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.product_id, e.timestamp, p.price

objects.name: product_comparable_outcomes
objects.sql: SELECT e.product_id, e.timestamp, pp.product_id AS peer_product_id, MAX(m.timestamp) AS peer_prediction_time, ARG_MAX(m.ltv, m.timestamp) AS peer_matured_ltv, DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(m.label_window_end), e.timestamp) AS days_since_peer_window_end FROM eval_table e JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.product_id JOIN product pp ON pp.product_id <> e.product_id AND pp.brand = p.brand AND pp.category[2] = p.category[2] AND pp.price = p.price JOIN matured_labels m ON m.product_id = pp.product_id AND m.label_window_end < e.timestamp AND m.timestamp < e.timestamp WHERE p.price >= 0 AND pp.price >= 0 AND p.brand IS NOT NULL AND p.brand <> '' AND p.category[2] IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.product_id, e.timestamp, p.price, pp.product_id, pp.price QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.product_id, e.timestamp ORDER BY ABS(pp.price - p.price), MAX(m.label_window_end) DESC, pp.product_id) <= 3
